category_title: Young child with severe autism engaging in physical aggression
scenario_title: One-on-one instruction labeling picture cards after circle time
minimal_context: Lauren is sitting at a table for one-on-one instruction to label picture cards immediately following morning circle time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Lauren, circle time is over. Let's sit at the table and look at these picture cards. Tell me what is on this card.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the card. What do you see?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this activity. Look at the next card.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams loudly, kicks the teacher's leg, and grabs the teacher's clothing)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Lauren, circle time is over. Let's sit at the table and look at these picture cards. Tell me what is on this card.

STUDENT: No.

TUTOR: Please look at the card. What do you see?

STUDENT: (Pushes the picture cards away) Done.

TUTOR: We need to finish this activity. Look at the next card.

STUDENT: (Screams loudly, kicks the teacher's leg, and grabs the teacher's clothing)

task.content: academic activity selected from their IEP (labeling picture cards for Lauren)

context.time_context: immediately following morning circle time, in which demands were placed on the students in a large group setting

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: instructed to complete an academic activity... using a least-to-most prompting hierarchy
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: screaming, pushing, kicking, and grabbing teachers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: increased the aversiveness of the tasks Lauren was asked to complete, which may have increased the value of escape

behavior_patterns.condition: during the escape test condition (40% of trials)
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: hitting or kicking another individual or grabbing another persons’ body or clothing... Episodes of aggressive behaviors lasted up to 2 min
